sources.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
sources.description: 800,000+ economic time series — GDP, interest rates, inflation, employment, housing, commodities, monetary policy indicators

endpoints.name: Search for data series
endpoints.returns: List of matching time series with IDs, titles, frequency, and metadata

endpoints.name: Get data observations
endpoints.returns: Recent data points for a series (date + value pairs)

sources.notes: Free API key required. 120 requests/minute limit. Best source for US economic data.

sources.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS)
sources.description: Employment, wages, prices, productivity, and workplace safety data for the United States

endpoints.name: Get series data
endpoints.returns: Time series data with year, period, value, and footnotes

endpoints.name: Get series data (no key)
endpoints.returns: Same as above but limited to 10 years, 25 queries/day without key

sources.notes: Works without key (25 queries/day, 10-year limit). Free key raises to 500 queries/day and 20 years.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau
sources.description: Demographics, business statistics, housing data, economic indicators, and population surveys for the United States

endpoints.name: American Community Survey (1-year)
endpoints.returns: Tabular data with requested variables for specified geography

endpoints.name: County Business Patterns
endpoints.returns: Number of establishments, employees, and annual payroll by NAICS code

sources.notes: Free key required. 500 queries/day. Extensive variable catalog at api.census.gov/data.html

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.description: 240M+ academic works, authors, institutions, and concepts. LLM-optimized API with structured metadata, abstracts, and citation data

endpoints.name: Search works
endpoints.returns: Academic works with title, authors, publication year, citation count, abstract, DOI, and open access URL

endpoints.name: Search works with filters
endpoints.returns: Filtered works sorted by citation count

endpoints.name: Get concepts/topics
endpoints.returns: Academic concepts with descriptions, related concepts, and work counts

sources.notes: No API key needed. Polite pool: add ?mailto=your@email to get into faster queue. 100K requests/day.

sources.name: Semantic Scholar
sources.description: 200M+ academic papers with AI-powered relevance ranking, citation contexts, and influential citation detection

endpoints.name: Search papers
endpoints.returns: Papers with title, authors, year, citation count, abstract, and open access PDF link

endpoints.name: Get paper details
endpoints.returns: Full paper details including references and citing papers

sources.notes: No API key needed for basic access. 100 requests/5 minutes without key. Request API key for higher limits.

sources.name: CrossRef
sources.description: DOI metadata, citation counts, and bibliographic records for 150M+ scholarly works across all disciplines

endpoints.name: Search works
endpoints.returns: Works with DOI, title, authors, publication date, citation count, journal name

endpoints.name: Get work by DOI
endpoints.returns: Full metadata for a specific DOI including references

sources.notes: No API key needed. Add ?mailto=your@email for polite pool (faster). Be respectful of rate limits.

sources.name: PubMed / NCBI
sources.description: 39M+ biomedical and life science citations including clinical trials, systematic reviews, and medical research

endpoints.name: Search PubMed
endpoints.returns: List of PubMed IDs matching the search query

endpoints.name: Get article summaries
endpoints.returns: Article summaries with title, authors, journal, publication date, and DOI

endpoints.name: Get article abstracts
endpoints.returns: Full abstracts in plain text format

sources.notes: No API key needed. 3 requests/second without key. Add api_key parameter for 10 req/sec.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.description: 16,000+ development indicators for 200+ countries — health expenditure, GDP, population, education, infrastructure

endpoints.name: Get indicator data
endpoints.returns: Time series data for a specific indicator and country

endpoints.name: Search indicators
endpoints.returns: List of matching indicators with codes and descriptions

sources.notes: No API key needed. Use 'all' for country_code to get all countries. Date format: 2020:2025 for ranges.

sources.name: OECD Data
sources.description: Economic, social, and environmental data for OECD member countries — health, education, labor, trade, productivity

endpoints.name: Get dataset
endpoints.returns: SDMX-formatted time series data

endpoints.name: Get health data (simpler)
endpoints.returns: Health statistics in JSON format

sources.notes: No API key needed. SDMX format can be complex. Consider using the simpler stats.oecd.org endpoint for health data.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.description: Company filings, financial statements, and disclosure data for all US public companies

endpoints.name: Full-text search filings
endpoints.returns: Search results with filing links, company names, dates

endpoints.name: Company filings
endpoints.returns: Company info and recent filings list with form types and dates

endpoints.name: Company facts (XBRL)
endpoints.returns: All XBRL facts (revenue, assets, etc.) reported by the company

sources.notes: No API key needed. MUST set User-Agent header to 'CompanyName email@example.com'. 10 requests/second limit.

sources.name: USPTO (Patent Data)
sources.description: Patent applications, grants, and trademark data for innovation and technology landscape analysis

endpoints.name: Search patents
endpoints.returns: Patents with number, title, date, and assignee organization

sources.notes: No API key needed for PatentsView. Complex query syntax but powerful filtering.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage
sources.description: Stock prices, forex rates, crypto data, and technical indicators for financial market analysis

endpoints.name: Company overview
endpoints.returns: Company fundamentals: market cap, PE ratio, revenue, profit margins, sector

endpoints.name: Income statement
endpoints.returns: Annual and quarterly income statements

endpoints.name: Monthly stock prices
endpoints.returns: Monthly OHLCV data for a stock

sources.notes: Free key required. Free tier: 25 requests/day. Sufficient for targeted queries.

sources.name: CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
sources.description: Medicare/Medicaid enrollment, spending, quality measures, hospital compare data, and procedure pricing

endpoints.name: Hospital Compare
endpoints.returns: Hospital quality ratings, patient experience scores, and outcomes

endpoints.name: Medicare Spending by Claim
endpoints.returns: Medicare spending per beneficiary by hospital

endpoints.name: Physician Compare
endpoints.returns: Physician demographics, specialties, and practice locations

sources.notes: No API key needed. Government open data. Rate limits generous but unspecified.

sources.name: Turquoise Health (Hospital Pricing)
sources.description: Hospital price transparency data — actual negotiated rates for procedures across US hospitals

endpoints.name: Search prices
endpoints.returns: Price ranges for a procedure by hospital and insurance plan

sources.notes: Free for research use. API availability may vary. Website has extensive browseable data.

sources.name: LiteLLM Model Pricing
sources.description: Open-source model-pricing map: per-token input/output (and cache) rates across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, etc.). Used to ground LLM/agent-build token cost for feature-ROI and token-forecast economics.

endpoints.name: Full model-pricing map (JSON)
endpoints.returns: Object keyed by model name; each entry has input_cost_per_token, output_cost_per_token, cache_creation_input_token_cost, cache_read_input_token_cost, max_tokens, and provider metadata

sources.notes: No API key needed — it's a static JSON file in the LiteLLM repo, updated frequently. Rates are API LIST PRICES. IMPORTANT: when used to cost Cascade's own agent builds, label the figure 'standard-rate-equivalent', NOT Cascade's actual Max-Plan $0. Pair with BLS OEWS (occupation 15-1252, software developers) for the human-effort side of build cost.
